name: Prochlorperazine
effects: Phenothiazine antipsychotic at high doses; dopamine antagonist
Anti-nausea and antivertigo at low doses
Akathisia (intense restlessness) — a significant and underrecognized effect
Anticholinergic side effects at higher doses
halfLifeNotes: Single-dose terminal t½ in healthy young males: 9 ± 1 h IV and 8 ± 2 h oral; the same study measured 18 ± 4 h after 14 days of 25 mg twice-daily dosing, so the previous 18 h value was the steady-state accumulation figure.
